title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges or portal users, to access item master records without proper permission checks. Exploitation can lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive item data such as costing and purchase rates.
